from object_detector import Object_Detector_Tool

# Initialize variable to store detected items and their number
detected_objects = {}

# Sample image path
sample_image_path = "/mnt/data8/liao/wxie/SAT/SAT_images_train/1617_0.png"

# Specify the number of languages to use (in this case, English and German)
num_languages = 2

# Try to extract text detection results using the multi-language text detection tool
result = Object_Detector_Tool.execute(image=sample_image_path, languages=["en", "de"])

# Parse the detection results and extract the objects
for line in result:
    detected_objects.update({**line[1]})

# Check if there was at least one detected object
if detected_objects:
    detected_objects = detected_objects.values()
    object_number = any([len(detected_objects) for detected_objects in detected_objects.keys()])

    # Generate the output
    final_result = "\nNumber of detected objects: " + str(object_number)
    text_data = ""

    for label, detected_objects in detected_objects.items():
        if len(detected_objects) > 1:
            text_data += f"{' - '.join(sorted([detected_objects[-1][0]})}) - count: {len(detected_objects)}\n"
        else:
            text_data += f"{'-'.join(sorted([detected_objects[0][0]]))} - count: {len(detected_objects[0][1])}\n"

    final_result += f"Text detected: {text_data}"
else:
    final_result = "No objects detected in the image."
